Container.Name: nullGuard
Container.Overview:
WireGuard VPN management application for creating and managing VPN servers and clients.
For the full documentation of this project, please visit: https://github.com/nullata/nullGuard/

Config.Name: WireGuard UDP Port
Config.Description: WireGuard server UDP port. Add additional UDP port mappings for each extra WireGuard server instance.

Config.Name: SERVER_PORT
Config.Description: Container-side port the web UI listens on. Must match the WebUI Port Target value above.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Your UTC TZ offset. List of available TZs: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones

Config.Name: DB_HOST
Config.Description: Your MariaDB/MySQL database host or container name

Config.Name: DB_PORT
Config.Description: MariaDB/MySQL database port

Config.Name: DB_USER
Config.Description: The designated user for this application in the database. For more info on the requirements, please visit: https://github.com/nullata/nullGuard/blob/main/README.md#database-setup

Config.Name: DB_PASS
Config.Description: Your MariaDB/MySQL database user password.

Config.Name: DB_NAME
Config.Description: Your MariaDB/MySQL database name. For more info on the requirements, please visit: https://github.com/nullata/nullGuard/blob/main/README.md#database-setup

Config.Name: DB_TYPE
Config.Description: Database backend: mysql (default) or sqlite. To use sqlite: set this to 'sqlite', then manually add a Path mapping (e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/nullguard/data) to /data inside the container so the database file persists across updates.

Config.Name: SERVER_SSL_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable SSL for the web UI. Default: false.

Config.Name: SESSION_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Secret key for session encryption. Auto-generated if not set, but highly recommended to set a random value to prevent all users being logged out on container update.

Config.Name: SESSION_MAX_AGE
Config.Description: Maximum session age in seconds. Default: 3600.

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Set secure flag on cookies. Enable when using SSL. Default: false.

Config.Name: ENV
Config.Description: Environment mode. Set to production for secure session cookies. Default: production.

Config.Name: WG_SERVER_DEFAULT_NAME
Config.Description: Default interface name for new WireGuard servers.

Config.Name: WG_SERVER_DEFAULT_COMMENT
Config.Description: Default comment for new WireGuard servers.

Config.Name: WG_SERVER_DEFAULT_ADDR
Config.Description: Default address in CIDR notation for new WireGuard servers.

Config.Name: WG_SERVER_DEFAULT_PORT
Config.Description: Default WireGuard listen port for new servers.

Config.Name: WG_SERVER_DEFAULT_SUPERNET
Config.Description: Default supernet CIDRs for new servers.

Config.Name: WG_SERVER_DEFAULT_KEEPALIVE
Config.Description: Default client keepalive in seconds (0-600) for new servers.

Config.Name: WG_SERVER_DEFAULT_CONF_PATH
Config.Description: Default config file path for new WireGuard servers.

Config.Name: WG_SERVER_CONF_PATH
Config.Description: Path inside the container where WireGuard server configs are generated. Not mandatory to persist via volume - server configurations are stored in the database and regenerated from there on startup.

Config.Name: WG_CLIENT_DEFAULT_NAME
Config.Description: Default name for new WireGuard clients.

Config.Name: AUTO_START_SERVERS
Config.Description: Automatically start all WireGuard servers on application startup. Default: false.
